lines.text: 量测闭环：厚度、形貌和缺陷要一起看

lines.en: Metrology loop: thickness, morphology and defects must be assessed together

lines.en: Remaining film thickness / planarity / defect density / electrical performance and yield

lines.text: 01 工艺流程：从来料到放行的量测闭环
lines.zh: 工艺流程：从来料到放行的量测闭环
lines.en: Process flow: metrology loop from incoming material to release

lines.text: 量测数据反馈，持续优化过程稳定性
lines.zh: 量测数据反馈，持续优化过程稳定性
lines.en: Feed metrology data back to continuously improve process stability

lines.en: Improved mean thickness may still conceal

lines.text: 交叉验证后，再决定放行、隔离或根因分析
lines.zh: 交叉验证后，再决定放行、隔离或根因分析
lines.en: Cross-validate before deciding release, hold or root-cause analysis
Locate the issue and define countermeasures

lines.text: 异常不等于立即修改配方，
lines.zh: 异常不等于立即修改配方，
lines.en: An anomaly does not mean immediately changing the recipe;

lines.text: 应先排除来料、量测、设备和魠材图察
lines.zh: 应先排除来料、量测、设备和耗材因素
lines.en: first exclude incoming-material, metrology, equipment and consumable factors.
